title: Paint your own Doormat
seo_title: Paint Your Own Christmas Doormat Workshop in Bolivar, MO
description: This is a Christmas doormat painting workshop where you choose your colors, add your own touch, and paint a festive welcome mat for your door. You can come solo, bring a friend, or make it a creative date; two people can share one mat for $25 total, each additional doormat is $25, and all supplies are provided. It takes place November 28, 2026 (Time TBD) at The Creative Root, 115 N Main Ave in Bolivar, MO, and space is limited, so reserve in advance and tell the organizer whether one or two people will attend.
address: 115 N Main Ave, Bolivar, MO 65613-1517, United States, Bolivar, MO
